message.reasoning:
The user asks:

1) "Please tell me the price of Zelda Breath of the Wild (薩爾達傳説：曠野之息) on US Nintendo Switch."
2) Also ask whether Super Mario Odyssey has a special discount ("特价") on same platform/region? Actually they say "同樣的平台與地區", so check if Super Mario Odyssey is on sale on US Nintendo Switch.

3) They also want to query what currency is used on US PlayStation platform.

4) And then give the price of God of War on UK PlayStation platform.

We need to use the defined tool calls. We have three functions:
video_games_store_currency(platform, region?)
video_games_on_sale(game_title, platform, region?)
video_games_store_price(game_title, platform, region?)

We'll call them accordingly.

First get price of Zelda on US Nintendo Switch -> video_games_store_price with game_title="Zelda Breath of the Wild"? But Chinese name given; we can pass English or maybe local. Use "Breath of the Wild". Platform=Nintendo Switch, region=United States.

Second check if Super Mario Odyssey is on sale on US Nintendo Switch -> video_games_on_sale with game_title="Super Mario Odyssey".

Third fetch currency used on US PlayStation platform -> video_games_store_currency with platform="PlayStation", region="United States"

Fourth fetch price of God of War on UK PlayStation platform -> video_games_store_price with game_title="God of War", platform="PlayStation", region="United Kingdom"

Let's do sequentially. We'll produce separate calls. Probably best to chain but each call separately. Let's output after all results. We'll first call price of Zelda. Then sale status of Mario. Then currency. Then price of God of War. Provide answers in Chinese as requested.
